rationale_summary: This document is a compilation of public comments on NIST's AI Risk Management Framework RFI. The framing centers on managing AI risks to users and the public through a standardized framework, consistent with consumer/public safety governance. Secondary frames are evident from submitters including rights organizations (EPIC, Color of Change), catastrophic risk institutes (Future of Life, Global Catastrophic Risk Institute), and industry innovation groups.

evidence_spans.quote: Comments Received in Response to the Request for Information about Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
